summary: Sumter County lookout tower on Shaw AFB land; a January 2026 inspection found it deteriorated and a March 2026 memo recommends demolition.

facts.design: Galvanized steel Aermotor, consistent with the LS-40 type, with an inside stairway
facts.status_note: Standing at a January 2026 inspection. A March 2026 memo recommends demolition; no source we read says whether that has happened.

access.note: Land on Shaw Air Force Base, in the natural area around the Poinsett Electronic Combat Range. No source we read describes public access.

events.note: Shaw Air Force Base acquired the unused site, which lay in the former Manchester State Forest
South Carolina Department of Archives and History found the site eligible for the National Register of Historic Places on April 7
Section 106 review of a rehabilitation and treatment plan for the Rosemary Center for Natural and Cultural Resources
Structural investigation on 22 January; memo dated 23 March recommends demolition

notes_for_editor: No build year found: the 1995 NRHP form is restricted, and a Shaw AFB article that may date the complex to 1936 returned 403, so no build date is used. The Forest Fire Lookout Association Facebook post calling the tower slated for demolition was seen only in search results and is not used. The brief's ownership 'state' is outdated after the 1994 acquisition (see corrections). Story numbering matches the sources array.
